description: This file defines the ProxyBackend class implementing server backend logic for managing MCP providers, clients, and tools in a Playwright-related project. It includes methods for initializing connections, listing tools, switching connection methods, and handling client communication.

classes.name: ProxyBackend
classes.description: Implements server backend for managing MCP providers, clients, and tools, including connection switching and client communication.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend with server, client version, and roots, and sets the current MCP client.

methods.name: listTools
methods.description: Returns a list of available tools, including a context switch tool if multiple providers are available.

methods.name: callTool
methods.description: Calls a specified tool by name with arguments, handling context switch if needed.

methods.name: serverClosed
methods.description: Handles server closure by closing the current client.

methods.name: _callContextSwitchTool
methods.description: Handles switching the connection method to a different MCP provider.

methods.name: _defineContextSwitchTool
methods.description: Defines the tool used to switch between different MCP connection methods.

methods.name: _setCurrentClient
methods.description: Sets the current MCP client by connecting to a specified provider.
